independence_instructions: This is an AI-assisted audit and does not satisfy the independent-human annotation requirement.
Use only public task, quality, scenario, metric, overlay, source, and test evidence.
Do not inspect reference branches, solution patches, or model-generated answers.
rationale: TinyDB separates query, utility, and document-operation contracts from the shared storage, table, database, and middleware state stack. Table search and caching consume QueryLike, freeze, and LRU behavior, while integrated state depends on consistent document IDs and invalidation. The bootstrap only removes class-definition blockers; the asymmetric state-agent workload is documented but does not make the split artificial.
